verdict.rationale: Extensive first-party documentation and SDKs (Python, npm) plus GitHub library confirm a documented, versioned REST API with API keys, endpoints, rate limits, pricing, and multiple client options (SDKs, CLI, raw HTTP), directly matching the story. Missing for 10: no independent third-party OpenAPI spec discovery (404s on openapi.json probes) and no hands-on developer confirmation of API robustness beyond docs.
